GOLDFINCH Mangaluru
Nestled in the heart of Mangalore, Goldfinch Hotel offers an elegant blend of comfort and convenience. Its well-appointed rooms are complemented by modern amenities and attentive service, ensuring a memorable stay. Culinary delights await at Sana-di-ge, the hotel’s signature coastal restaurant, renowned for its authentic flavors and exceptional service . Adding to the gastronomic experience is Kni Hau, the Chinese restaurant, offering authentic Chinese cuisine at competitive prices. For events and gatherings, the hotel boasts a spacious banquet hall making it an ideal venue for both intimate and grand occasions.

DINING
Sana-di-ge is a tribute to the rich culinary heritage of India’s West Coast, where traditional recipes have been lovingly passed down through generations. Our journey began with a simple yet profound philosophy – bringing the comforting flavors of home-cooked coastal delicacies to our guests. At the heart of Sana-di-ge lies the authentic touch of
Mrs. Asha Shetty, Director of MRG Group
, whose treasured family recipes form the soul of our menu. Our chefs, trained under her expert guidance, recreate dishes with the same precision, warmth, and devotion as a mother’s kitchen – offering a dining experience that feels like home.
KNI HAU invites you to explore the rich and nuanced flavours of Chinese cuisine, right in the heart of Mangaluru. From delicately steamed dim sums to bold wok-tossed creations, each dish is thoughtfully prepared using fresh ingredients and authentic techniques. The restaurant offers a refined yet relaxed setting, where tradition meets taste in every bite. Whether you’re a connoisseur or just discovering Chinese cuisine, KNI HAU promises an experience that is both comforting and unforgettable.
